response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack engineer with strong systems and tooling background, but his recent and dominant experience is in TypeScript/Node.js and DLang, with no evidence of Kotlin work and only minor, dated Java exposure (robotic arms tooling, an in-house mobile orchestration tool). There is no demonstrated experience with the Spring ecosystem, JVM internals, enterprise application servers, or IDE tooling development, all of which are core requirements for this role.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience across web, embedded, and systems programming
Proven track record building and maintaining developer tools, test frameworks, and CI infrastructure
Strong communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source community involvement
concerns: No visible Kotlin experience and only minimal, outdated Java usage
No evidence of Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise JVM framework expertise
No direct experience with IDE internals or language tooling development

key_factors.factor: No IDE internals or language tooling background
Strong general software craftsmanship and tooling experience
